items.name: Retração Escapular na Puxada Alta
items.movement: Scapular pulldown: seated facing high cable machine, wide overhand bar above head, elbows remain STRAIGHT throughout; depress shoulder blades, moving torso up slightly and shoulders away from ears, then release. Only small scapular movement, no elbow bending.

items.name: Puxada de Trenó com Corda (Sled Pull)
items.movement: Rope sled pull: athlete seated on floor with knees slightly bent, heavy sled several meters in FRONT, rope between hands and sled. Pull rope hand-over-hand toward waist, sled moves toward athlete. Six stages alternating hands grip farther forward and pull back. Show full athlete rope and sled, fixed camera.

items.name: RDL no Landmine (Bilateral ou Unilateral)
items.movement: Bilateral landmine Romanian deadlift: bar anchored in floor hinge BEHIND in distance, athlete faces loaded FREE end held with BOTH hands in front of thighs. Slight fixed knee bend, hip hinge lowers loaded end near shins, neutral back, stand again. Keep bar attached to fixed anchor, weights at hand end.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho Deitado na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Prone low cable leg curl on flat bench: ankle cuffs on BOTH ankles linked to LOW pulley behind feet, torso and thighs prone supported, knees just beyond bench edge. Flex knees from almost straight to90degrees pulling cable, hips fixed, then lower.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho Unilateral na Bola Suíça
items.movement: Single-leg Swiss ball hamstring curl: supine shoulders on floor, ONE left heel on Swiss ball, right leg lifted straight into air and never touches ball. Hips elevated throughout; bend left knee to roll ball toward buttock then extend left leg rolling ball away. Keep shoulders floor and hips lifted.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho no TRX / Fita de Suspensão
items.movement: Suspension hamstring curl: supine shoulders and arms on mat, BOTH heels in two suspension strap cradles from fixed overhead anchor beyond feet. Hips elevated, bend knees bringing heels to buttocks, straps swing toward body, then extend knees. Both heels remain cradled.

items.name: Step-up Cruzado (Cross-over Step-up)
items.movement: Cross-over step-up: athlete beside a stable knee-high box, right leg crosses in FRONT of left leg to plant right foot on box to athlete's left. Extend right leg standing on box, left foot lifts clear, then lower back to floor. Box fixed, cross-over path evident.

items.name: Levantamento Terra Sumô com Halter ou Kettlebell (Em cima de dois steps)
items.movement: Deficit sumo kettlebell deadlift: stand one foot on EACH of TWO separate sturdy low steps, feet wide and toes outward, kettlebell held with BOTH hands centered in GAP between steps. Bend hips/knees lower bell into gap, extend hips/knees stand. Heels fixed on steps.

items.name: Agachamento Ajoelhado no Smith ou com Barra (Kneeling Squat)
items.movement: Barbell kneeling squat: kneel BOTH knees on thick mat, barbell across upper back, knees never leave mat. Start tall kneeling with hips extended, sit hips back toward heels via hip flexion, then extend hips tall again. No standing, feet remain behind.

items.name: Desenvolvimento por Trás da Nuca com Barra (Behind-the-Neck Press)
items.movement: Seated behind-the-neck barbell shoulder press: rear three-quarter camera clearly shows bar BEHIND head at upper trapezius level, wide grip; press vertically overhead to straight arms, then lower bar BEHIND head again. Neutral head no neck flexion, fixed torso.

items.name: Remada Alta com Barra Reta ou W (Pegada Média/Aberta - foco em Deltoide Lateral)
items.movement: Wide-grip EZ-bar upright row standing: hands wider than shoulder width, bar in front thighs; raise elbows out sideways drawing bar to LOWER chest only, upper arms at or slightly below horizontal. Wrists below elbows, neutral torso, lower.

items.name: Remada Alta no Smith
items.movement: Smith machine upright row: bar held with wide overhand grip in front thighs, bar attached TWO vertical guide rails; elbows lift out sideways pulling bar to lower chest, upper arms no higher than shoulders, lower. No squat.

items.name: Remada Alta Unilateral com Halter ou na Polia (Monkey Row)
items.movement: Unilateral dumbbell monkey row: standing, ONE right dumbbell at side held neutral grip, bend elbow and lift elbow laterally up to below shoulder height, dumbbell travels beside right ribs; left arm relaxed. Lower right arm. No biceps curl.

items.name: Elevação Frontal na Polia Baixa com Corda (Puxando por entre as pernas)
items.movement: Rope cable front raise between legs: athlete faces AWAY from LOW pulley behind body, rope passes BETWEEN legs, both hands holding rope ends in front thighs. Straight arms raise forward to shoulder level then lower, cable runs through legs throughout.

items.name: Elevação Frontal na Polia Baixa com Barra
items.movement: Low cable bar front raise: athlete faces low pulley in FRONT, straight bar wide enough shoulder grip both hands, raise straight arms FORWARD from thighs to shoulder level then lower. Cable taut from bar center to low pulley.

items.name: Elevação Frontal Deitado de Costas no Banco Inclinado
items.movement: Supine incline bench dumbbell front raise: back supported on45degree bench, head on backrest, feet floor. Two dumbbells start arms down alongside hips, raise straight arms FORWARD until arms near horizontal in front shoulders, then lower. Torso remains supine supported.

items.name: Elevação Frontal com Peito Apoiado no Banco Inclinado
items.movement: Prone incline bench dumbbell FRONT raise: chest supported on45degree bench, feet floor, two dumbbells hang below shoulders. Raise straight arms FORWARD toward head into Y aligned with inclined torso, not out to sides. Keep torso supported and elbows straight.

items.name: Crucifixo Inverso Unilateral na Polia
items.movement: Unilateral rear-delt cable reverse fly: standing side-on to cable pulley set shoulder height, right hand holds handle from LEFT side of body across chest; pull right arm horizontally outward to right maintaining slight elbow bend, rear deltoid orange. Torso fixed, no elbow row.

items.name: Remada para Deltoide Posterior com Halteres (Cotovelos abertos a 90°)
items.movement: Prone bent-over dumbbell rear-delt row: standing hip hinge torso near horizontal, two dumbbells hanging below shoulders; row by bending elbows FLARED90degrees sideways, dumbbells rise near upper ribs, then lower. Elbows bend visibly unlike reverse fly.

items.name: Extensão de Ombro para Trás na Polia ou com Halteres (Skiers / Rear Delt Kickback)
items.movement: Dumbbell skier rear-delt kickback: standing hip hinge torso45degrees, arms initially vertical with elbows almost STRAIGHT, extend BOTH shoulders moving straight arms behind torso past hips, then return. Elbows stay nearly straight, no triceps extension.

items.name: Rosca Scott na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Cable preacher curl: seated at preacher bench inclined arm pad, BOTH upper arms supported against pad and elbows stationary; straight bar attached LOW pulley in FRONT. Flex elbows bar toward face then extend, upper arms never leave pad.

items.name: Rosca Duplo Bíceps na Polia Alta (High Cable Curl / Posição de pose)
items.movement: High cable double biceps curl: standing CENTER between two high pulleys, arms out horizontally to sides in T, handle in EACH hand. Keep upper arms horizontal fixed, bend BOTH elbows bringing hands toward temples in double-biceps pose then extend. Cables from hands to high side pulleys.

items.name: Rosca Hércules Unilateral na Polia Alta
items.movement: Unilateral high cable Hercules curl, upper arm horizontal and fixed; curl toward temple then extend.

items.name: Rosca Arrasto com Halteres
items.movement: Dumbbell drag curl, elbows move behind torso and weights slide close to body.

items.name: Rosca com Barra H / Romana (Pegada Neutra)
items.movement: Neutral-grip Roman H-bar curl using parallel inner handles.
